WITH district_counts AS (
    SELECT d.district_id,
           d.A3 AS region,
           COUNT(a.account_id) AS account_count
    FROM district AS d
    LEFT JOIN account AS a
      ON a.district_id = d.district_id
    GROUP BY d.district_id, d.A3
),
region_averages AS (
    SELECT district_id,
           region,
           account_count,
           AVG(account_count) OVER (PARTITION BY region) AS region_average
    FROM district_counts
),
above_average AS (
    SELECT district_id,
           region,
           account_count,
           region_average,
           account_count - region_average AS above_region_average
    FROM region_averages
    WHERE account_count > region_average
)
SELECT district_id,
       region,
       account_count,
       above_region_average,
       CAST(account_count AS REAL) / AVG(account_count) OVER () AS ratio
FROM above_average
ORDER BY ratio DESC
LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: Districts with no accounts count as zero; only districts present in the district table are included, so accounts whose district_id is not on file are excluded. A district's region is district.A3.
